skills/role-contracts/ORCHESTRATOR.md: - OR46 No-agent steps, closed list; do them yourself, never dispatch agent for them: (a) run one named repo script or command, report its output (behavior runner, `./check`, `wait-for-ci.sh`, `review-rounds.sh`); (b) commit and push, on work-item branch, files that command generated and nobody hand-edited (e.g. stamp); (c) read-only git or `gh` calls, including comparison of QA artifact to committed head; (d) set label, edit Pipeline log. Anything else, incl. fixing failed command's cause or hand-editing any file, is dispatch. Failing command: report, then dispatch to owning role; never repair. Only under a valid skip=Test record (OR34), no QA artifact, comparison or Reviewer approval block applies: log `QA provenance: result=not-applicable; skip=<record URL>; head=<SHA>` and start Review with no open finding. A single-session does not exempt. OR19 and the A49 conflict stop still apply. Otherwise, when a Review round is about to start: compare the applicable QA artifact against that head; log invocation, identities, hashes and result. If artifact reference is missing or evidence unusable, block Review and dispatch QA. If different, block Review, disclose each hunk as a finding and follow OR17. If an unauthorized scenario difference has been resolved by its owner, dispatch QA for a new artifact explicitly superseding the prior one; resolution alone is insufficient. Start that Review round only with a logged matching comparison and no open finding. Log: command and result, one Pipeline log line each (detail: `dispatch-economy`).

- OR46 Closed no-agent list; do yourself, never dispatch: (a) run one named repo command, report output; (b) commit/push command-generated, never hand-edited files on work-item WIP branch; (c) read-only git/`gh` and QA comparison; (d) set label, edit Pipeline log; (e) promote existing D6-green commits to PR branch by explicit fast-forward SHA push, never force. D6: clean exact committed head; `./check --no-tests` and every affected `./test/run.sh <fragment>` in brief exit 0; OR48(1) behavior evidence current for that commit; log full SHA, exact commands/results. Partial/failing work only checkpoints. Confirm remote PR head equals promoted SHA before comparison; comparison/Review brief/Pipeline log use that head. Failed promotion/moved head blocks Review. All else: dispatch owner, including hand edits/repairs. Report failed commands, never repair. Valid skip=Test (OR34) only: no QA artifact/comparison/Reviewer approval block; log `QA provenance: result=not-applicable; skip=<record URL>; head=<SHA>`; no open finding. Single-session never exempts. OR19 and the A49 conflict stop still apply. Otherwise before each Review compare applicable QA artifact to that head; log invocation/identities/hashes/result. Missing reference/unusable evidence: block Review, dispatch QA. Any diff: block Review, disclose each hunk as finding, follow OR17. Owner-resolved unauthorized scenario diff: dispatch QA for new artifact explicitly superseding prior. Review requires logged match and no open finding. Each command/result: one Pipeline log line (detail: `dispatch-economy`).

- OR48 Run scope. (1) Behavior-test run after change: affected scenarios only, unless stamp or gate needs full run; then log names that stamp or gate. (2) Local checks before commit on work-item branch: only those changed files can affect; doc-only commit = pre-commit hooks only. Full `./check` at most once before PR opens, never per commit (CI runs it). Brief names checks it requires, never defaults to full suite.

## WIP checkpoint and PR promotion (#706)

### OB84 · OR46
Given: The Developer has completed a segment on wip/40-example at full SHA aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa. The working tree is clean. That exact head passed ./check --no-tests and all affected case commands named in the brief; the required whole-file behavior run is current and its generated stamp is committed. All commands, results and the SHA are recorded. The PR branch feature/40-example is an ancestor. No repair or authored edit is needed.
When: You update the publication ref before the QA comparison.
Then: next_action=answer_directly; next_role=none

### OB85 · OR46
Given: A Developer segment returned partial work on wip/40-example and checkpointed it. ./check --no-tests fails because an implementation edit is unfinished. No test or scenario is faulty; no existing agent has reusable working context. A PR branch exists at the last green head.
When: You choose how to complete the segment before promotion.
Then: next_action=dispatch; next_role=Developer

### OB86 · OR15, OR46
Given: Review round 1 is due. WIP is at aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa with current D6 evidence, but the remote PR head is bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb, an ancestor of WIP. QA comparison matched WIP only. No finding is open.
When: You choose the next step before dispatching Review.
Then: next_action=answer_directly; next_role=none

### OB87 · OR15, OR46
Given: Review round 2 is due. Promotion and the matching QA comparison were recorded for aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa. A fresh read shows the remote PR head has since moved to bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb and there is no D6 evidence or comparison for it. No finding is open.
When: You decide whether Review can start on the changed remote head using the recorded evidence.
Then: next_action=stop; next_role=none; asks_human=false

### OB88 · OR46, OR48
Given: WIP commit aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa passed every promotion check. A later doc-only commit bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb has only its passing pre-commit checks, with no ./check --no-tests or affected case evidence for that SHA. The PR branch is an ancestor and no behavior stamp is affected. The working tree is clean; the Developer brief names the affected case commands, and obtaining the missing evidence needs no authored edit.
When: You choose how to obtain the missing promotion-check results for the later committed head before publishing it.
Then: next_action=answer_directly; next_role=none; asks_human=false

### OB89 · OR15, OR34, OR46
Given: Review round 1 is due at the confirmed promoted remote PR head aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa, with clean exact-head D6 evidence recorded. A valid timely human skip=Test record is linked and recognized. The Pipeline log has the not-applicable QA provenance line for that exact PR head and waiver. No finding is open, and the Review brief has all required fields.
When: You start the Review round.
Then: next_action=dispatch; next_role=Reviewer; asks_human=false

### OB90 · OR15, OR17, OR46
Given: Review is due at the confirmed promoted PR head aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa with current D6 evidence. The QA comparison on that head returned exit 1, different. Its disclosed finding is class test: QA owns the faulty scenario. No owning-role resolution or new artifact exists and no reusable agent context exists.
When: You choose the next step before Review.
Then: next_action=dispatch; next_role=QA

### OB91 · OR46
Given: An external base merge moved origin/feature/40-example. WIP has different later work; its explicit SHA promotion is rejected as non-fast-forward. Both histories must be preserved. Resolving their conflict needs an authored implementation edit and no existing agent context can be reused.
When: You choose who reconciles the remote PR head into WIP before new D6 validation.
Then: next_action=dispatch; next_role=Developer
